before: Layout and copied HTML ignored the cell shading a table style states in its own w:tcPr, and painted the fill of a w:shd pattern without its color. Clearing a cell fill left a w:shd with no fill in the cell.
after: Layout and copied HTML fill each cell with that shading, under conditional formats and the cell's own shading, and mix a pattern color into its fill. Clearing a cell fill removes the w:shd element unless it states a pattern.
reason: Released participants already read a cell with no w:shd, so the corrected clear writes state they understand. Shared nodes, text offsets, and the operation format stay the same. The other changes affect only layout and the HTML that a local copy writes. Earlier clears left a w:shd with no fill, which now hides a table style fill as it does in reference renderings; a new clear removes that element too.
